title: Ida: Name Meaning, Origin & Personality
summary: Ida is a charming and historic name with deep roots in Germanic and Greek traditions. It offers a wonderful blend of vintage appeal and modern simplicity.
meaning: Industrious, prosperous, or from Mount Ida
origin: The name Ida has a rich dual heritage. Primarily, it derives from the Old High German word 'itis,' meaning work, carrying connotations of diligence and productivity. Additionally, it connects to Greek mythology as the name of a sacred mountain on the island of Crete, associated with the nurturing of the infant Zeus. While its exact etymological roots are occasionally debated among historians regarding whether the Germanic or classical forms predominated early usage, the name gained widespread European adoption through medieval royalty and literature, remaining a beloved classic in Scandinavia and beyond today.
personality: Ida is often associated with a bright, independent, and resilient spirit. People with this name are frequently perceived as natural leaders who combine quiet determination with a warm, welcoming presence. There is a steadfast and reliable quality to Ida, making her someone others look to for guidance and support. Believers in name associations often view an Ida as possessing a curious mind, a deep appreciation for nature and history, and a creative spark that allows her to approach everyday challenges with grace, originality, and quiet confidence.
popularity: Ida enjoys enduring popularity across Northern Europe, particularly in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Germany, where it is cherished as a timeless traditional choice. It also sees a steady and affectionate following in English-speaking countries among parents seeking a short, elegant vintage name that stands out gracefully without being overly complicated.

faq.q: What is the primary meaning of the name Ida?
faq.ans: The name most commonly means industrious or hardworking in Germanic roots, while also connecting to a sacred mythological mountain in Greek tradition.

faq.q: How do you pronounce the name Ida?
faq.ans: It is typically pronounced EYE-duh in English-speaking countries, while European pronunciations may place a slightly softer emphasis on the vowels.

faq.q: Does Ida have many common nicknames?
faq.ans: While the name is already wonderfully short at three letters, affectionate diminutives like Iddie are sometimes used by family and close friends.
